topic: EXP-653 — new "Two mathematical kill-shots" module inserted into the overview tab (build-scripts/generate-html.js) between thesis-hero and verdict-bars, with decider-corrected anchor links (#p2-schumann/#p2-axial → real anchor ids)

holes_found.description: The new .ds-headline-killshots module uses a fixed inline two-column grid (style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1.2rem") with NO @media breakpoint to collapse to a single column on narrow viewports. Every sibling module on the same overview tab has one: .ds-thesis-hero .ds-thesis-figures collapses at max-width:760px and max-width:420px; .ds-falsifiability-module .ds-fm-row collapses at max-width:720px. grep confirms zero @media rules reference "headline-killshots" anywhere in build-scripts/generate-html.js. This is exactly the risk EXP-653’s own review_notes_for_curmudgeon.likely_holes flagged ("the grid-template-columns:repeat(2,...) fixed 2-col layout will overflow on narrow viewports without a @media breakpoint. Add a mobile fallback.") and it was not addressed at integration.
holes_found.recommendation: Add a @media(max-width:720px) rule for .ds-headline-killshots mirroring the sibling modules’ pattern: collapse "display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))" to a single column (grid-template-columns:1fr) below ~720px, consistent with .ds-falsifiability-module’s breakpoint on the same page.
